away.summary: The Canadiens are projected to use the same lineup from their 3-2 season-opening win over the Toronto Maple Leafs. They will be without scratched players Florian Xhekaj and Adam Engstrom, plus injured Kaiden Guhle (adductor) and Oliver Kapanen (lower body). No players are listed as doubtful or returning for this game.

doubtful.detail: Penguins coach Dan Muse said no decision has been made on his status; he participated in optional morning skate but availability uncertain
week to week; took part in morning skate but status uncertain for game

returning: returning from lower-body injury; took full contact in practice and was activated from injured reserve Saturday
home.summary: The Penguins are projected to start Arturs Silovs in goal. They will be without scratched Ilya Solovyov and Elmer Soderblom, plus injured Justin Brazeau (lower body), Ryan Graves (knee), Bryan Rust (upper body, week to week), and Blake Lizotte (lower body, status undecided). Ben Kindel is returning from a lower-body injury after being activated from injured reserve, while Lizotte and Rust are doubtful as game-time decisions.
